text: I really like the app! It's almost exactly what I am looking for. I wish the "checklist" also had the option to count towards the tasks, like subtasks (for when you want to add tasks to a note for instance), and that you would automatically complete a task when you checked off the whole checklist/all subtasks. I do love the fact that you have the option to see just the timeline of today in the widget!
author: Malissa Veenstra
